# Security floor: FastMCP 2.13.0.2 and Authlib 1.5.2 are flagged by the
# image vulnerability gate. Keep these overrides until mcp-agent-mail's
# transitive constraints move past the fixed versions. FastMCP < 3.4.10 has
# GHSA-7xgj-8392-5q4r; fastmcp exact-pins fastmcp-slim to its own version, so
# this floor moves both.
fastmcp>=3.4.10
# Authlib < 1.9.0 has CVE-2026-96760 (CRITICAL, empty-signature JWS JSON
# validation), CVE-2026-114615 and CVE-2026-114617..114620; < 1.9.1 adds
# CVE-2026-114616 (HIGH, empty HMAC key forgery). mcp-agent-mail v0.3.2 caps
# authlib <1.6, hence an override rather than a floor. It only uses
# authlib.jose JsonWebKey/JsonWebToken for optional JWT auth, which 1.9.1 keeps.
authlib>=1.9.1

# Security floor: CVE-2026-48526 (HIGH, auth bypass) in PyJWT < 2.13.0, and
# CVE-2026-102268 (CRITICAL) plus CVE-2026-102266/-102267/-102271/-102272/
# -102273 (HIGH, authentication bypass and token forgery) in PyJWT < 2.14.0.
# CVE-2026-101918 and CVE-2026-102275 (MEDIUM) affect PyJWT <= 2.14.0.
# CVE-2026-69247 affects cryptography < 50.0.0. python-multipart and starlette lower-severity
# issues in the same Trivy scan. Remove once transitive deps carry fixed versions.
pyjwt>=2.15.0
cryptography>=50.0.0
python-multipart>=0.0.30
starlette>=1.1.0
